statements.statement: Free cash used to balance this year's budget becomes a structural deficit going into next year.
Weights and measures costs expected in FY26 budget request.
Town manager will request funds at fall town meeting to continue the Mart transportation program.
Only a small delta in the operating budget is available for new borrowing; other debt is under debt exclusions.
Additional Chapter 70 from the state to be placed on fall warrant as supplemental appropriation to the schools.

warnings.prediction: Town manager will be challenged to present a balanced budget without the school budget until March.
Capital plans will not be extensive and most capital accounts are underfunded.
